sector_notes: Communication services (XLC +4.9% over the week), consumer discretionary (XLY +1.9%), financials (XLF +1.2%), consumer staples (XLP +0.7%) and real estate (XLRE +1.9%) were relative leaders. Technology (XLK -8.2%), semiconductors (SMH -11.2%; SOXX -13.1%) and energy (XLE -12.0%) remain the clearest weekly breakdowns; SPY lost 2.7% and QQQ 5.0% from 30 October to 6 November despite Friday's rebound. Friday breadth improved, with 63.5% of 5,952 U.S. tickers trading more than 100,000 shares closing above the open, but this is a stabilization signal rather than a confirmed broad risk-on reversal.
